import json, random, sys, time
sys.path.insert(0,'/workspace/dev'); sys.path.insert(0,'/workspace/vendor'); sys.path.insert(0,'/workspace/submission')
import verify, controller, perf
n = int(sys.argv[1]) if len(sys.argv)>1 else 8
J = int(sys.argv[2]) if len(sys.argv)>2 else 128
S = int(sys.argv[3]) if len(sys.argv)>3 else 128
cases=[]
for i in range(n):
    cases.append(perf.rich_case(J=J,S=S,seed=100+i,q=4,B=6,R=4,cmax=200,span=3))
req={'version':3,'cases':cases}
raw=json.dumps(req).encode()
print('input bytes', len(raw))
t=time.time(); resp=controller.run(raw); dt=time.time()-t
print('batch %d epochs J=%d S=%d: %.2fs' % (n,J,S,dt))
try:
    verify.check_request(req,resp)
    print('verified OK; sizes', [len(r['flow']) for r in resp['results']])
except Exception as e:
    print('FAIL', type(e).__name__, str(e)[:200])
print('out bytes', len(json.dumps(resp)))
